From 4797a3dd46f220e6d83daf54d70c5b33db6deb01 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lucas Stach <l.stach@pengutronix.de>
Date: Wed, 31 Jan 2024 13:00:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] media: imx: csc/scaler: fix v4l2_ctrl_handler memory leak

Free the memory allocated in v4l2_ctrl_handler_init on release.

Fixes: a8ef0488cc59 ("media: imx: add csc/scaler mem2mem device")
Signed-off-by: Lucas Stach <l.stach@pengutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Philipp Zabel <p.zabel@pengutronix.de>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil-cisco@xs4all.nl>

diff --git a/drivers/staging/media/imx/imx-media-csc-scaler.c b/drivers/staging/media/imx/imx-media-csc-scaler.c
index 1fd39a2fca98..95cca281e8a3 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/media/imx/imx-media-csc-scaler.c
+++ b/drivers/staging/media/imx/imx-media-csc-scaler.c
@@ -803,6 +803,7 @@ static int ipu_csc_scaler_release(struct file *file)
 
 	dev_dbg(priv->dev, "Releasing instance %p\n", ctx);
 
+	v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(&ctx->ctrl_hdlr);
 	v4l2_m2m_ctx_release(ctx->fh.m2m_ctx);
 	v4l2_fh_del(&ctx->fh);
 	v4l2_fh_exit(&ctx->fh);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File Modified**: `drivers/staging/media/imx/imx-media-csc-scaler.c`
   - **Modification**: Added a call to `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(&ctx->ctrl_hdlr);` in the `ipu_csc_scaler_release` function. This change ensures that the memory allocated for the control handler is freed when the instance is released, preventing a memory leak.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a memory leak issue that was introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `a8ef0488cc59`), which added the CSC/scaler mem2mem device. By freeing the control handler memory during the release process, the patch effectively resolves the memory management issue that arose from that earlier change.

Here is the commit message:
media: imx: csc/scaler: fix v4l2_ctrl_handler memory leak

Free the memory allocated in v4l2_ctrl_handler_init on release.

Fixes: a8ef0488cc59 ("media: imx: add csc/scaler mem2mem device")
Signed-off-by: Lucas Stach <l.stach@pengutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Philipp Zabel <p.zabel@pengutronix.de>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil-cisco@xs4all.nl>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the lack of a memory deallocation step for the control handler in the `ipu_csc_scaler_release` function, which led to a memory leak when instances of the CSC/scaler device were released without freeing the allocated memory for the control handler.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int ipu_csc_scaler_release(struct file *file)
 {
 	struct ipu_csc_scaler_priv *priv = video_drvdata(file);
 	struct ipu_csc_scaler_ctx *ctx = fh_to_ctx(file->private_data);
 
 	dev_dbg(priv->dev, "Releasing instance %p\n", ctx);
 
+	v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(&ctx->ctrl_hdlr);
 	v4l2_m2m_ctx_release(ctx->fh.m2m_ctx);
 	v4l2_fh_del(&ctx->fh);
 	v4l2_fh_exit(&ctx->fh);
 	kfree(ctx);
 
 	return 0;
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
struct ipu_csc_scaler_ctx *ctx = fh_to_ctx(file->private_data);
```
```c
v4l2_m2m_ctx_release(ctx->fh.m2m_ctx);
```
```c
// Missing memory deallocation for ctx->ctrl_hdlr
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the `ipu_csc_scaler_release` function does not include a step to free the memory allocated for the control handler (`ctx->ctrl_hdlr`). As a result, when instances of the CSC/scaler device are released, the memory allocated for the control handler remains allocated, leading to a memory leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(&ctx->ctrl_hdlr);
```
Reason:
This statement is added to the `ipu_csc_scaler_release` function to properly deallocate the memory associated with the control handler (`ctx->ctrl_hdlr`). By calling `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free`, the allocated memory is freed, preventing the memory leak that occurred when instances of the device were released without this deallocation step.
